g.text: Spatial validation narrows apparent model performance

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'Open Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #727272

g.text: Municipal participation remains the most predictable outcome; mean, provincial, and federal participation follow in order.

g.text: Lines show the validation gap for the same saved model family; spatial folds are the more conservative test of geographic generalization.
